figures.alt: R03, raw CT label and r04
figures.caption: R04 follows the lobe outline without reproducing raw axial terraces. The reverse view retains the lower lobe indentation.
The left trio stays within 2.32 mm. An additional parallel section 0.75 mm from the center has a 4.13 mm in-plane miss and a 0.64 mm local 3D distance.
Five sagittal sections stay within 0.84 mm. The transverse entry preserves the connection between lobes.
R03 and r04 use the same pose and scan images. The overlay shows the gland above the tracheal air column.
The probe and grid partly obscure the gland in the default view. The axial orbit and overlay help locate the lobe and its bridge.
